additional_info.subject: 170000464- Failures in vehicle charging on the part of the charging station
additional_info.body:
Dear Team, good morning
At the charging station there are many problems with charging vehicles.
Charging ends in a few minutes, a lot of time.
I am attaching an Excel table sent by the client within the last day, it shows the amount of charging interruptions.
I would appreciate your help in checking the charging position as soon as possible.
It is important for me to say that I know that the charging stand is not under warranty, but we have permission from Afonso and Michele to test the charging station from the support side.
Br,
Orel.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0398328-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / P4 170000464] Charging Issue CRM:00643001196
additional_info.body:
D
ear Shrey, good morning
Yesterday we replaced Bender monitors at the charging station, and even after the replacement, the end of charging stopped after about 10 minutes for a random customer who arrived at the station.
I would like to please investigate the transaction and know what caused it to end.
The problem is with 2 charging cables, I find it hard to believe that 2 cables are faulty because some people have charging, and the cable test goes through the charger and there is no mention of a temperature fault.
I would appreciate it if you could investigate yesterday's transaction:
transactionId":63257
I would like to understand why the car charging ended in the current transaction
Br,
Orel.

additional_info.subject: NOC_Handover
additional_info.body: AI : We need to analyze the logs as mentioned by the region in the latest email. The charging session was interrupted within 10-15 minutes. We need to check the DC cable wiring and resistance values. The previous logs are attached for your reference. We're also getting IMD issue but after replacing also the problem remains the same.
